lines.en: Hey, Joey. How'd the audition go?
Incredible. I met the director this time,
and you will never believe who it was.
Whoo!
All right, I'll give you one hint.
Warren Beatty.
Wow!
Yeah, there's just one thing that might be kind of a problem.
See, I, uh, I had to kiss this guy.
Because he was just so darn cute?
No, as part of the audition.
See, I'm up for the part of this guy who the main guy kisses.
Well, hey, you're an actor.
I say, uh, you just suck it up and you do it.
Or you just do it.
I did do it. I'm a professional.
So what's the problem?
See, after the scene, Mr. Beatty comes up to me and he says,
"Good actor, bad kisser."
Can you believe that?
Me. Not a good kisser.
That's like... like Mother Teresa.
Not a good mother.
Ah, come on. Who cares what that guy thinks?
You know, what does Warren Beatty know about kissing?
Oh.
Hey, what'd your agent say?
Yep.
This kiss thing is definitely a problem.
Mr. Beatty wants to see it again on Monday.
Man, I gotta figure out what I'm doing wrong.
Oh, okay.
One of you girls will come over here and kiss me.
Forget it.
All right.
Hey, come on. I need your help here.
All right. I'll do it.
I've kissed him before. I can do it again.
See this? Huh? This is a friend.
Uh-huh. Let's go.
Oh, wait. I have a gun.
Oh.
Okay.
Good. Very good. Firm but tender.
I'd recommend you to a friend.
Then I don't know what it is. What's the problem?
Joey, you know, maybe you're just not used to kissing men.
You know, maybe you just tensed up a little bit.
Maybe that's what you need to work on.
Yeah, that makes sense.
Over my dead body.
And I'll be using his dead body as a shield.
All right.
I've been feeling incredibly guilty about this because I want to be a good friend.
And damn it, I am a good friend, so just shut up and close your eyes.
Wow.
You are a good friend.
Of course, the audition was this morning and I didn't get it.
But that was a hell of a kiss.
Rachel is a very lucky girl.
